```{r}
## Load packages
if(!require(tidyverse)) install.packages(tidyverse)
if(!require(brms)) install.packages(brms)
if(!require(patchwork)) install.packages(patchwork)
if(!require(lme4)) install.packages(lme4)
if(!require(easystats)) install.packages("easystats")
if(!require(MuMIn)) install.packages("MuMin")
if (!require(ggnewscale)) install.packages("ggnewscale")

## Load data
ecoreg <- readRDS( "outputs/Ecoregions_emep_grid.rds")
globnut <- readRDS("outputs/02_GlobNut_subsampled.rds") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(biomass = log(biomass),
         spec_ric = log(spec_ric + 1),
         q1 = log(q1 + 1),
         q2 = log(q2 + 1),
         ndep = log(ndep/100/5), # to g/ha/yr
         ndep_cent = ndep - mean(ndep),
         MAP = log(MAP),
         PET = PET,
         NP = log(NP),
         MAP_cent = MAP - mean(MAP),
         PET_cent = PET - mean(PET, na.rm = TRUE),
         MAT_cent = MAT - mean(MAT),
         NP_cent = NP - mean(NP),
         biomass_cent = biomass - mean(biomass)) %>% 
  mutate(across(c("ndep", "NP", "MAT", "MAP", "PET", "biomass", "pH_soilgrids"), ~scale(.x)[,1],  .names = "{.col}_scaled")) %>% 
  left_join(ecoreg, by = "cell") %>% 
  drop_na(pH_soilgrids)

hab_label_table <- read.csv("~/Data/Globnut_offline/_GLOBNUT1.0/Globnut1.0_EUNIS.csv") %>% 
  dplyr::select(habitat = sub_class, eunis_label2) %>% 
  distinct()

# colors
colours_lim <- c('#d95f02','#1b9e77', '#7570b3')
np_mean <- mean(globnut$NP) 
np_sd <- sd(globnut$NP)
np_vals <- (log(c(5,15,20))-np_mean)/np_sd # NP values to predict on 
unstand_np <- function (x) { x*sd(globnut$NP) + mean(globnut$NP)}
count_limits <- c(0,50) # color scale density annotation plot counts
stand_plot <- 10 # plot size to adjust prediction to
unstand_ndep <- function (x) { x*sd(globnut$ndep) + mean(globnut$ndep)}
unstand_biomass <- function (x) { x*sd(globnut$biomass) + mean(globnut$biomass)}
```

## Biomass
```{r}
full_model_biomass <- lmer(biomass ~ MAT_scaled + PET_scaled + MAP_scaled +  
                             NP_scaled + ndep_scaled + NP_scaled:ndep_scaled + 
                             (1 + ndep_scaled |habitat) + (1|dg_cell), data = globnut, na.action = "na.fail")

summary(full_model_biomass)
check_model(full_model_biomass)

# Run model selection
dd <- dredge(
  full_model_biomass,
  subset = ndep_scaled & NP_scaled,  # Always include focal variable
  rank = "AICc"
)

selected_models_biomass <- subset(dd, delta <= 2)

selected_model_biomass <- lmer(get.models(dd,1)[[1]],
                          data = globnut)
summary(selected_model_biomass)
check_model(selected_model_biomass)
```

```{r}
# plot annotation
biomass_limits <- c(0, 1000) 

# Ndepostion effect on biomass by stoichiometry
biomass_pred <- 
  ggeffects::ggpredict(selected_model_biomass,
                                 terms = c("ndep_scaled [all]", "NP_scaled [np_vals]")) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(group = unstand_np(as.numeric(as.character(group))) %>% exp() %>% round() %>% as.factor()) 
biomass_ndep_np <- ggplot(data = globnut, aes(x = exp(ndep), y = exp(biomass))) +
    geom_hex() +
    scale_fill_gradient("Count",low = "grey90", high = "grey40", limits = count_limits) +
    new_scale_fill() + 
    geom_ribbon(data = biomass_pred, aes(x =  exp(unstand_ndep(x)), 
                                     y = exp(predicted), 
             fill = group, col = group, ymin = exp(conf.low), 
             ymax = exp(conf.high)), alpha = .5, col = NA) +
    geom_line(data = biomass_pred, aes(x =  exp(unstand_ndep(x)), 
                                     y = exp(predicted), col = group)) +
    scale_fill_manual("N/P", values = colours_lim) +
    scale_color_manual("N/P", values = colours_lim) +
    scale_y_continuous(Biomass~(g~m^-2), limits = biomass_limits) +
    scale_x_continuous(Average~annual~N~deposition~(kg~ha^-1), trans = "log",
                     breaks = c(1,2,5,10,20,60),
                     labels = c(1,2,5,10,20,60)) +
  theme_bw() 
biomass_ndep_np
```
## q0
```{r}
full_model_q0 <- lmer(spec_ric ~ MAT_scaled + PET_scaled + MAP_scaled + pH_soilgrids_scaled + log(plot_size) +
                             NP_scaled +  ndep_scaled + I(ndep_scaled^2) + ndep_scaled:NP_scaled + 
                        biomass_scaled + I(biomass_scaled^2) + (1 + ndep_scaled + I(ndep_scaled^2)| habitat) + (1|dg_cell),
                      data = globnut, na.action = "na.fail")

summary(full_model_q0)
check_model(full_model_q0)

# Run model selection
dd <- dredge(
  full_model_q0,
  subset = ndep_scaled & NP_scaled,  # Always include focal variables
  rank = "AICc")

selected_models_q0 <- subset(dd, delta <= 2)

selected_model_q0 <- lmer(get.models(dd,1)[[1]],
                          data = globnut)
check_convergence(selected_model_q0)
isSingular(selected_model_q0)
summary(selected_model_q0)
check_model(selected_model_q0)
```

```{r}
## calculate optimum ndep level for different levels of np
# calculate confidence interval by bootstrapping
set.seed(123)
nrep <- 1000
optimum_ndep <- matrix(ncol = length(np_vals), nrow = nrep)
for (i in 1:nrep) {
  random_sample <- globnut[sample(1:nrow(globnut), size = round(nrow(globnut)*0.7)),] # run on 70% of the data
  mod_output <- lmer(formula(selected_model_q0),
                          data = random_sample)
  ndep_coef <- fixef(mod_output)["ndep_scaled"]
  ndep2_coef <- fixef(mod_output)["I(ndep_scaled^2)"]
  np_ndep_coef <- fixef(mod_output)["ndep_scaled:NP_scaled"]
  optimum_ndep[i,] <- -(ndep_coef + np_ndep_coef * np_vals) / 
    (2 *   ndep2_coef)
}
estimated_optimum <- data.frame(NP_scaled = np_vals,
                              ndep_scaled = apply(optimum_ndep, 2, median) ,
                              ci_low = apply(optimum_ndep, 2, quantile,  
                                             probs = 0.025),
                              ci_up = apply(optimum_ndep, 2, quantile,  
                                            probs = 0.975)) %>% 
  mutate(group = unstand_np(as.numeric(as.character(NP_scaled))) %>% exp() %>% round() %>% as.factor()) 

# plot annotation
q0_limits <- c(0, 75) 
specric_optimum <- c(40,42,45)

# Ndepostion effect on q0 by stoichiometry
q0_pred <- 
  ggeffects::ggpredict(selected_model_q0,
                                 terms = c("ndep_scaled [all]",
                                           "NP_scaled [np_vals]")) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(group = unstand_np(as.numeric(as.character(group))) %>% exp() %>% round() %>% as.factor()) 
q0_ndep_np <- ggplot(data = globnut, aes(x = exp(ndep), y = exp(spec_ric))) +
    geom_hex() +
    scale_fill_gradient("Count",low = "grey90", high = "grey40", 
                        limits = count_limits) +
  new_scale_fill() + 
     geom_errorbar(data = estimated_optimum, 
               aes(x = exp(unstand_ndep(ndep_scaled)),
                   xmin = exp(unstand_ndep(ci_low)), 
                   xmax = exp(unstand_ndep(ci_up)),
                   y = specric_optimum)) +
    geom_point(data = estimated_optimum, 
               aes(x = exp(unstand_ndep(ndep_scaled)),
                   y = specric_optimum,
                   fill = group),
               size = 1.5, shape = 21) +
    guides(fill = "none") +
    scale_fill_manual("N/P", values = colours_lim) +
    new_scale_fill() + 
    geom_ribbon(data = q0_pred, aes(x = exp(unstand_ndep(x)), 
                                     y = exp(predicted), 
             fill = group, col = group, ymin = exp(conf.low), 
             ymax = exp(conf.high)), alpha = .5, col = NA) +
    geom_line(data = q0_pred, aes(x = exp(unstand_ndep(x)), 
                                     y = exp(predicted), col = group)) +
    scale_fill_manual("N/P", values = colours_lim) +
    scale_color_manual("N/P", values = colours_lim) +
    scale_y_continuous("Species richness (q0)", limits = q0_limits) +
    scale_x_continuous(Average~annual~N~deposition~(kg~ha^-1), trans = "log",
                     breaks = c(1,2,5,10,20,60),
                     labels = c(1,2,5,10,20,60)) +
  theme_bw() 
q0_ndep_np

q0_np_biomass <- ggeffects::ggpredict(selected_model_q0, 
                                          terms = c("biomass_scaled [all]", 
                                                    "NP_scaled [np_vals]", 
                                                    "plot_size [stand_plot]"))  %>%
    as.data.frame() %>% 
    mutate(group = unstand_np(as.numeric(as.character(group))) %>% 
             exp() %>% round() %>% as.factor())
q0_np_biomass <-           
   ggplot(data = globnut, aes(x = exp(biomass), y = exp(spec_ric))) +
    geom_hex() +
    scale_fill_gradient("Count", low = "grey90", high = "grey40",  limits = count_limits) +
    new_scale_fill() + 
    geom_ribbon(data = q0_np_biomass, aes(x = exp(unstand_biomass(x)), 
                                     y = exp(predicted), 
             fill = group,  ymin = exp(conf.low), 
             ymax = exp(conf.high)), col = NA, alpha = .5) +
    geom_line(data = q0_np_biomass, aes(x =  exp(unstand_biomass(x)), 
                                     y = exp(predicted), col = group)) +
    scale_fill_manual("N/P", values = colours_lim) +
    scale_color_manual("N/P", values = colours_lim) +
    scale_y_continuous("Species richness (q0)", limits = q0_limits) +
    scale_x_log10(Biomass~(g~m^-2)) +
  theme_bw()
q0_np_biomass

```


```{r}
## calculate optimum ndep level for different levels of np for the habitats
# calculate confidence interval by bootstrapping
optimum_results <- list()
habs <- c("R1","R2","R3")
for(j in 1:length(np_vals)) {
  optimum_results[[j]] <- matrix(NA, nrow =  length(habs), ncol = nrep)
}
for (i in 1:nrep) {
  for (j in 1:length(np_vals)) {
  random_sample <- globnut[sample(1:nrow(globnut), size = round(nrow(globnut)*0.7)),] # run on 70% of the data
  mod_output <- lmer(formula(selected_model_q0),
                          data = random_sample)
  ndep_coef <- fixef(mod_output)["ndep_scaled"] + ranef(mod_output)$habitat[habs, "ndep_scaled"]
  ndep2_coef <- fixef(mod_output)["I(ndep_scaled^2)"] + ranef(mod_output)$habitat[habs, "I(ndep_scaled^2)"]
  np_ndep_coef <- fixef(mod_output)["ndep_scaled:NP_scaled"]
  optimum_results[[j]][,i] <- -(ndep_coef + np_ndep_coef * np_vals[j]) / 
    (2 *   ndep2_coef)
  }
}
estimated_optimum_hab <- lapply(1:length(optimum_results), function(j) {
  data.frame(NP_scaled = np_vals[j],
             habitat = habs,
             ndep_scaled = apply(optimum_results[[j]], 1, median) ,
             ci_low = apply(optimum_results[[j]], 1, quantile, probs = 0.025), 
             ci_up = apply(optimum_results[[j]], 1, quantile, probs = 0.975))}) %>% 
  bind_rows() %>% 
  mutate(group = unstand_np(as.numeric(as.character(NP_scaled))) %>% 
           exp() %>% round() %>% as.factor())

pred_data_hab <- 
 ggeffects::ggpredict(selected_model_q0,
                                 terms = c("ndep_scaled [all]", "NP_scaled [np_vals]", "habitat [habs]"),
                      type = "random") %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(group = unstand_np(as.numeric(as.character(group))) %>% 
           exp() %>% round() %>% as.factor())

plot_hab <- function(hab_name, plot_title) {
  ggplot(data = globnut[globnut$habitat == hab_name,], aes(x = exp(ndep), y = exp(spec_ric))) +
    geom_hex() +
    scale_fill_gradient("Count",low = "grey90", high = "grey40", 
                        limits = count_limits) +
    new_scale_fill() + 
    geom_errorbar(data = estimated_optimum_hab[estimated_optimum_hab$habitat == hab_name,],
               aes(x = exp(unstand_ndep(ndep_scaled)),
                   y = c(60,62,65),
                   xmin = exp(unstand_ndep(ci_low)),
                   xmax = exp(unstand_ndep(ci_up)))) +
    geom_point(data = estimated_optimum_hab[estimated_optimum_hab$habitat == hab_name,], 
               aes(x = exp(unstand_ndep(ndep_scaled)),
                   y = c(60,62,65),
                   fill = group ),
               size = 1.5, shape = 21) +
    scale_fill_manual("N/P", values = colours_lim) +
    guides(fill = "none") +
    new_scale_fill() + 
    geom_ribbon(data = pred_data_hab[pred_data_hab$facet == hab_name,], 
                aes(x = exp(unstand_ndep(x)), 
                                     y = exp(predicted), 
             fill = group, col = group, ymin = exp(conf.low), 
             ymax = exp(conf.high)), alpha = .5, col = NA) +
    geom_line(data = pred_data_hab[pred_data_hab$facet == hab_name,],
              aes(x = exp(unstand_ndep(x)), y = exp(predicted), col = group)) +
    scale_fill_manual("N/P", values = colours_lim) +
    scale_color_manual("N/P", values = colours_lim) +
    scale_y_continuous("Species richness (q0)", limits = q0_limits) +
    scale_x_continuous(Average~annual~N~deposition~(kg~ha^-1), trans = "log",
                     breaks = c(1,2,5,10,20,60),
                     labels = c(1,2,5,10,20,60)) +
  ggtitle(plot_title) +
  theme_bw()
}
q0_r1 <- plot_hab("R1", "R1: Dry grasslands")
q0_r2 <- plot_hab("R2", "R2: Mesic grasslands")
q0_r3 <- plot_hab("R3", "R3: Seasonally wet and\nwet grasslands")
q0_u3 <- plot_hab("U3", "U3: Inland cliffs, rockpavements\nand outcrops")
q0_q2 <- plot_hab("Q2", "Q2: Valley mires, poor fens\nand transition mires")
q0_q5 <- plot_hab("Q5", "Q5: Helophyte beds")
```

```{r}
#biomass
model_parameters(selected_model_biomass) %>% 
  filter(Effects == "fixed") %>% 
  mutate(Parameter = str_remove(Parameter, "_scaled") %>%  
           str_remove("I\\(") %>% str_remove( "\\)") %>% str_remove("\\("),
         Parameter = case_when(Parameter == "ndep" ~ "N deposition (log)",
                               Parameter == "NP" ~ "N/P (log)",
                               TRUE ~ Parameter)) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  # Combine coefficient and SE
  mutate(`Estimate (SD)`= paste0(round(Coefficient, 3), " (", round(SE, 3), ")"),
       # Combine CI
       CI = paste0("[", round(CI_low, 3), ", ", round(CI_high, 3), "]"),
     `Significance level` = case_when(
       p < 0.001 ~ "***",
                    p < 0.01 ~ "**",
                    p < 0.05 ~ "*",
                    TRUE ~ ""),
        `p-value` = case_when(p < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
                              TRUE ~ as.character(round(p,4)))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(Parameter, `Estimate (SD)`, CI, `p-value`, `Significance level`) %>% 
  add_row(Parameter = c("Conditional R2", "Marginal R2"),
          `Estimate (SD)` = c(round(r2(selected_model_biomass)$R2_conditional, 3),
                          round(r2(selected_model_biomass)$R2_marginal,3)) %>% as.character()) %>%
  replace_na(list(`Estimate (SD)` = "-", CI = "-", `p-value` = "-", `Significance level` = "-")) %>% 

  knitr::kable(caption = "Model output biomass")


#q0
model_parameters(selected_model_q0) %>% 
  filter(Effects == "fixed") %>% 
  mutate(Parameter = str_remove(Parameter, "_scaled") %>%  
           str_remove("I\\(") %>% str_remove( "\\)") %>% str_remove("\\("),
         Parameter = case_when(Parameter == "ndep" ~ "N deposition (log)",
                               Parameter == "ndep^2" ~ "N deposition^2 (log)",
                               Parameter == "biomass" ~ "Biomass (log)",
                               Parameter == "biomass^2" ~ "Biomass^2 (log)",
                               Parameter == "logplot_size" ~ "Plot size (log)",
                               Parameter == "MAP" ~ "MAP (log)",
                               Parameter == "ndep:NP_scaled" ~ "N deposition:N/P",
                               Parameter == "NP" ~ "N/P (log)",
                               TRUE ~ Parameter)) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  # Combine coefficient and SE
  mutate(`Estimate (SD)`= paste0(round(Coefficient, 3), " (", round(SE, 3), ")"),
       # Combine CI
       CI = paste0("[", round(CI_low, 3), ", ", round(CI_high, 3), "]"),
     `Significance level` = case_when(
       p < 0.001 ~ "***",
                    p < 0.01 ~ "**",
                    p < 0.05 ~ "*",
                    TRUE ~ ""),
        `p-value` = case_when(p < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
                              TRUE ~ as.character(round(p,4)))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(Parameter, `Estimate (SD)`, CI, `p-value`, `Significance level`) %>% 
  add_row(Parameter = c("Conditional R2", "Marginal R2"),
          `Estimate (SD)` = c(round(r2(selected_model_q0, tolerance = 1e-07)$R2_conditional, 3),
                          round(r2(selected_model_q0,tolerance = 1e-07)$R2_marginal,3)) %>% as.character()) %>%
  replace_na(list(`Estimate (SD)` = "-", CI = "-", `p-value` = "-", `Significance level` = "-")) %>% 

  knitr::kable(caption = "Model output q-0")

```
